name: Planter box
blurb: A flower or herb planter for a porch or window sill, with holes so the water drains.

steps.text: Cut two sides, two ends and the bottom from the 1x6.
Drill three half-inch drain holes in the bottom.
Mark the screw spots 3/8 inch in from the ends of the sides, and drill small pilot holes there so the screws don't split the wood.
Screw the sides to the ends with outdoor screws to make a frame.
Set the bottom inside, 3/4 inch up from the ground, so water can drain out underneath. Drill pilot holes through the sides and screw into it.
Sand the top edges. Use cedar, or leave it unfinished inside, so it's safe for herbs.
